ops.body:
Correction after reading ccnhome.RecordWorktree (internal/ccnhome/ccnhome.go:249-278):
the second criterion is already satisfied. Registration DOES merge — it seeds
info.Worktrees from existing.Worktrees, appends the new worktree only when absent,
and sorts. So "records only the registering one" was wrong.

The accurate gap is narrower: nothing ever registers a worktree that never runs
`init`. This repo's entry lists only the agent worktree init happened to run in,
so the primary checkout is absent, and walk() (resolve.go:110-125) then returns
ErrUnknownRepo from the repo's own root. The fix is on the read side — match a
directory whose .git resolves to a known common_dir — or an idempotent
re-registration on ordinary commands, not a change to the merge logic.
